dataModel.section_0_points:
• Submit application online.
• Recruiting team reviews resume for relevant experience and skills.
• Initial screening for basic qualifications.
dataModel.section_1_points:
• Brief call with a recruiter to discuss your background, interest in the role, and salary expectations.
• Opportunity to ask initial questions about the company and role.
dataModel.section_2_points:
• Interview with a senior engineer focusing on technical skills.
• Typically involves coding challenges or system design questions.
dataModel.section_3_points:
• Series of interviews (4-6) with various team members and managers.
• Covers a range of topics: technical depth, problem-solving, behavioral questions, system design, and team fit.
• May include a whiteboard coding session or a take-home assignment review.
dataModel.section_4_points:
• Hiring Manager reviews feedback from all interviewers.
• Final assessment of candidate's overall fit and potential contribution.
dataModel.section_5_points:
• If successful, a formal offer is extended.
• Discussion of compensation, benefits, and start date.
dataModel.section_6_points:
• Completion of background checks and reference checks.
• Preparation for your start date and onboarding process.
